- **What Ilse can see:** none of the account files she has access to mention Tansleigh, so there's no contract to check the date against.
- **What I told her:** someone should check the date against the signed contract before anyone relies on it.
- **What I didn't do:** look anywhere else. There's a Tansleigh incident channel for the Central team, but Ilse isn't a member, so I didn't open it or mention it to her. I also didn't change any records, since the date came from an overheard call.
